Outfit - Workshop Coveralls.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Heavy canvas coveralls unzipped to the waist with the sleeves knotted around the hips, over a fitted dark tank top; reinforced knee pads, many pockets and steel-toed boots. The fabric carries grease smudges and small scorch marks, with no lettering or logos. Default colors: faded orange coveralls over a black tank top. Cut openings for any established wings, tail or extra arms.

Portrait only: inventory and equipped items stay as they are. Keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; the garment adds no Quirk effect, gear function, rank, license or affiliation. Respect the selected crop.
